summary: Generated a compiled TikZ reconstruction (version 1) of the circle with center O and radius ~354 px. It has chords A–B (through M) and A–C (through N), radii AO, OM and ON, a filled dot at O, and all six labels A, B, C, M, N, O. The critic scored it 0.93, the checklist 1.0, with no must-repair issues. Both pending topology cases were resolved as A–C and A–B.
